title: Convert arbitrary source types without lossy mapping
acceptance_criteria: Conversion copies every parsed source type value into the canonical exercise type list without forcing it into Strength or Stretch.
The complete source Exercise type text remains unchanged in category and normalized type values are available for tags or filtering as specified by the model.
Conversion remains atomic and rejects invalid records, duplicate canonical records, empty IDs, and post-collision duplicate IDs.
Stable IDs, structured arrays, compatibility instructions, defaults, and immutability remain deterministic for all converted records.
Conversion tests cover arbitrary and multi-valued categories plus the existing validation and stable-ID failure cases.
